text.text_excerpt: I stayed here for a long weekend trip to New Orleans. The first positive I want to bring up is the location. There's a lot of restaurants and bars nearby, so you'll have a lot of options for food. Ruby's is right across the street and that's worth a visit. You can easily walk to Bourbon Street and the French Quarter. The next positive was the staff. They were always friendly and smiled every time we try red for the day. The concierge gave us good tips of things to do in the area and went out of their way to help find us a good deal. The room itself was very pleasing. We had a one bedroom suite with a pullout couch. The bathroom was huge and the room was really clean.

My family and I stayed in a couple of rooms at La Belle Maison over Christmas and overall we all had a great experience! The two rooms we had were at the end of a hallway and were across from each other. We were able to keep both doors open for much of the time without bothering anyone, making floating back and forth between rooms very easy. One of the biggest draws for us was the hotel's great location. It's a stone's throw to the French Quarter and it's right off the trolley line. An easy walk to most of the CBD, Arts District, and Tremé. The rooms were very spacious, and I can attest that the pullout couch I had was much better than you would think. This was my first visit To NOLA and although I'm a Wyndham owner I would have definitely stayed here if I wasn't . It's a great location only a block away from Canal street and only two blocks from the French Quarter. It was nice and quiet and the room was very spacious. I had a one bedroom presidential which had a small stove and frig and coffee maker. The staff was super friendly upon our check in and made some great suggestions for places to eat and tours to take . We definitely enjoyed our trip and our stay here .
